interpretation.CATALOG_VALID_CURRENT: Validated against an approved current-game catalog; impossible until such a catalog exists.
interpretation.LEGACY_ALIAS: Matches a historical repository namespace only; this does not assert game truth or a canonical alias.
interpretation.UNVERIFIED: Contains a value with no current approved catalog interpretation.
interpretation.CONFLICT: The same record contains contradictory duplicate representations.
interpretation.UNKNOWN: No usable venue, tier, or box observation is present.
